claims.text: During construction in 1987, an ancient burial site of Native Hawaiians was uncovered, and the project was redesigned with the hotel shifted inland to preserve the sacred site.

findings.quote: During construction in 1987, crews uncovered an ancient burial site containing the iwi (bones) of Native Hawaiians dating as far back as 850 C.E.
The discovery led to a complete redesign of the project, shifting the hotel inland to preserve the sacred site and honor the ancestors who remain there.
